# CriticalMinerals.gl

Independent, source-led reference hub on Greenland’s strategic resources and enabling conditions.

## Canonical Resource

[Home](https://criticalminerals.gl/)

## Main Sections

- [Rare Earths](https://criticalminerals.gl/rare-earths/)
- [Energy](https://criticalminerals.gl/energy/)
- [Investment](https://criticalminerals.gl/investment/)
- [Sources](https://criticalminerals.gl/sources/)

## Purpose

CriticalMinerals.gl provides a stable reference gateway for Greenland’s critical minerals, rare earth elements, energy conditions, investment context and strategic supply-chain relevance.

## Administrative

No separate administrative resources are published.
